name: grafana-cloudwatch-cross-region-dashboards
description: Port or extend Grafana dashboards that query CloudWatch across AWS regions: {{Dim}} legend syntax never substitutes (use ${PROP('Dim.X')}), per-target region overrides defaultRegion with no new datasource or IAM, region-NAMED custom namespaces exist only in their own region, SEARCH matches dimension schemas exactly and has no regex, and every expression can be pre-validated verbatim through aws cloudwatch get-metric-data.
